rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-21 (EXTENSION iters 21-40 OPEN): does MORE EFFECTIVE TRAINING beat iter-7 hr 0.2515? MODEL byte-for-byte iter-7 (FoE nf24/k7/nb31 1920p + 1 alpha = 1921p, K=5 tied prox+DC, no momentum/per-step-alpha/learned-init); ONLY the TRAINER changes. DIAGNOSIS (binding constraint): under the 1080s wall the K=5 prox+DC is TRAINING-STARVED -- ~5 fwd/back-project pairs/sample/forward -> iter-7 did only ~8ep x 200 (~1.6k sample-passes) vs the 233k ITNet champion ~38k passes (k=1 + img-domain pretrain) -> 0.2515 is partly starvation not capacity. FIX = TWO-PHASE: (A) PROJECTION-FREE FoE denoiser pretrain D(x)=clamp(x-alpha*reg(x),0,clip_max) supervised LD-FBP->truth, pure img-domain MSE NO DC -> ~5x cheaper/step -> MANY epochs over the FULL 579 train pool (pretrain_train_n=579) in ~40pct of budget (pretrain_frac=0.40, ~432s); SAME reg+alpha Phase B finetunes so it drops in WARM; zero-init rho => D(x)=x at init. (B) end-to-end K=5 DC finetune (iter-7 objective) from the warm reg for the remaining ~648s, partial cosine peak 5e-3 (NOT >5e-3: iter-12 1e-2 DIVERGED; NOT constant: iter-15 DIVERGED). Total train<=1080s, val_n=214. AVOID (mapped dead ends iters 8-20): capacity-up (iter-8 DIVERGED), K>5 (iter-9 DIVERGED), momentum/per-step-alpha, learned-init (iter-10/11 FROZE), peak LR>5e-3, constant LR (iter-15), full anneal to 1e-5 (iter-13/14 OVERFIT). PARAMS UNCHANGED 1921. HYPOTHESIS: warm-started finetune reaches lower val-RMSE in-budget -> hr>0.2515.
